name: Pocket Watch
note: Pocket Watch: Make the gold case satin, with one narrow soft highlight on the upper-left rim and softer warm mid-tones elsewhere. Make the right side of the case and the lower right of the dial slightly darker. Keep the watch, the navy numerals, the chain, the green diamond backdrop and the view.

name: Folding Fan
note: Neckerchief (fan): Paint the fan folds as smooth rose-pink panels with no cloth weave, slightly deeper pink in the folds on the right, and make the lace edge one smooth cream scalloped band. Make the blue wave backdrop a slightly deeper medium blue, and put a soft shadow under the fan. Keep the fan, the ribs, the pivot and the view.
